newsitem.title: USA: Sherwood Group says Dresdner-NY to be sold. [CORRECTED 00:40 GMT 27/12]
newsitem.headline: Sherwood Group says Dresdner-NY to be sold. [CORRECTED 00:40 GMT 27/12]

text.p: The Sherwood Group Inc said New York Stock Exchange specialist firm Equitrade Partners agreed to acquire the specialist business of Dresdner-NY Inc., in which Sherwood has a limited partnership interest.
Sherwood did not disclose terms of the acquisition or its interest percentage. The acquisition is expected to close in the first quarter of 1997, Sherwood said.
Dresdner-NY is a NYSE specialist firm that trades 54 issues. Equitrade will be a specialist in 155 NYSE issues after the transaction, Sherwood added.
Sherwood also said that Dresdner president (Corrects from "vice president") John Nick Jr. and vice president David Green will join Equitrade as limited partners and specialists after the transaction.
